sections.Profile:
4 Queens is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in December 1970. Designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Christian Marche, it features a card and casino theme, popular in pinball machines of that era.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Castles, Single Player, Knights, Medieval, Original Theme, 1970s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Jim Patla
- Art: Christian Marche
